dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler? Great, you have perfect timing!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Do you remember the recipe you wrote for me the last time, when you and Ms. Kamisato came to my store?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, that pizza was so popular that many customers came to the store to order it specially.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But... some customers also said that they were bored of eating this pizza all the time and asked if I have other pizza flavors.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Although I have tried several methods to make new types of pizza based on feedback from customers...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But I always feel... that something is lacking, and the response from customers is not very good.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I'm really not good at making pizza...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, you know a lot about this dish, right? Can you give me some advice?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Great! By the way, I've also collected feedback from customers. Give me a moment, I'll look for it.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Miss Rie said that although the taste of this pizza is not bad...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: But she felt that the pizza would taste better if it incorporated some of Inazuma's local ingredients.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: I wonder what ingredients she would like to see... Traveler, please help me ask her.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Do you want to take a look at the customer feedback?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Give me a moment, I'll look for it.
